# Ronemus & Vilensky LLP

> NYC-based personal injury and civil rights law firm specializing in traumatic brain injuries, medical malpractice, police brutality, and construction accidents.

Ronemus & Vilensky LLP is a full-service personal injury and civil rights law practice serving New York City and the surrounding metropolitan area. The firm handles complex cases including medical malpractice, traumatic brain injuries, construction accidents, and civil rights violations with documented case results and attorney recognition.
